entries.chinese: 环境要求容器必须先打开，才能访问或修改其中的内容；并且 open 动作的校验依据是执行者当前所在位置是否为该容器本身，而不是其所属的家具。

entries.original: Navigate to the container itself, then open it with the appropriate open action. If it is already open, proceed; after opening, verify access before taking or placing. Do not issue open on a container from its parent furniture.
entries.chinese: 先导航到容器本身，再用合适的 open 动作打开它。如果它已经打开，就继续；打开后，在 take 或 put 之前先确认可以访问。不要从容器所属的家具处对容器发出 open。

entries.original: After several containers have been opened and no target found, repeatedly revisiting locations already confirmed empty can exhaust the action budget and cause failure. Similarly, when go to a named location returns 'Nothing happens', repeating it wastes steps; switching to another candidate is required.
entries.chinese: 在已打开多个容器仍未找到目标后，反复重访已确认空的位置会耗尽动作预算并导致失败。同样，当 go to 某个命名位置返回 'Nothing happens' 时，重复执行只会浪费步数；必须切换到另一个候选位置。

entries.original: Searching without tracking checked locations leads to redundant actions, while unchecked opened containers or visible surfaces may still contain the target. A no-change navigation indicates the target location is unreachable or invalid, so retrying it cannot help.
entries.chinese: 搜索时不记录已检查位置会导致冗余动作，而未检查的已打开容器或可见表面仍可能含有目标。导航无变化说明目标位置不可达或无效，因此重试它不会有帮助。

entries.original: Maintain a mental or explicit list of checked locations. Prioritize unchecked opened containers and visible surfaces; take a target directly if it is visible. Avoid revisiting a location already confirmed to have no target unless new evidence suggests otherwise. After one no-change navigation, pick a different unchecked location.
entries.chinese: 维护一份已检查位置的心理或显式列表。优先检查未检查的已打开容器和可见表面；如果目标可见，就直接 take 目标。避免重访已确认没有目标的位置，除非有新证据表明并非如此。一次导航无变化后，选择另一个未检查的位置。

entries.original: Repeatedly declaring a subtask complete without executing the required next action can trigger a loop guard and terminate the episode before the two items are placed. Re-taking an already-placed item and re-placing it at a different instance of the destination also causes a handoff loop guard.
entries.chinese: 在未执行所需下一步动作的情况下反复声明子任务完成，可能触发循环防护，并在两个物品放置完成前终止回合。重新 take 已放置的物品并将其重新 put 到目的地的另一个实例，也会触发交接循环防护。

entries.original: The current state may be misread as satisfying the completion condition even though the actual goal or subgoal is unfinished, causing repeated signals instead of progress; or the destination instance may be confused, leading to re-taking a placed item.
entries.chinese: 当前状态可能被误读为满足完成条件，即使实际目标或子目标尚未完成，导致反复发出信号而不是取得进展；或者目的地实例可能被混淆，导致重新 take 已放置的物品。

entries.original: Signal completion only after the corresponding subgoal is actually achieved, such as an object being taken or placed. After signaling, continue with the necessary next action and avoid repeating the same completion signal without new progress. Track which destination instance is the goal; once an item is placed at the target, do not re-take it—search for a second instance instead.
entries.chinese: 只有在相应子目标实际达成后才发出完成信号，例如物品已被 take 或 put。发出信号后，继续执行必要的下一步动作，避免在没有新进展的情况下重复同一完成信号。跟踪哪个目的地实例是目标；一旦物品被 put 到目标处，就不要重新 take 它——而应寻找第二个实例。

entries.original: For goals requiring a clean object to be placed, execute distinct stages: locate and acquire the target object; bring it to a compatible cleaning fixture, preferring a sinkbasin; clean it; confirm from the observation that cleaning succeeded; then go to the destination, open it if closed, and place the object. Do not place before cleaning, and do not treat the clean step as done unless the observation confirms it. If cleaning has not succeeded, return to the cleaning stage before attempting placement. If the chosen object repeatedly fails to clean, treat it as unsuitable and switch to a likely-cleanable candidate rather than looping. Treat placement confirmation as the terminal condition, not the clean step.
entries.chinese: 对于需要将干净物品放置到目标处的目标，执行不同阶段：定位并获取目标物品；将其带到兼容的清洁设施，优先选择 sinkbasin；清洁它；从观察中确认清洁成功；然后前往目的地，如果关闭则 open，并 put 物品。不要在清洁前 put，也不要将清洁步骤视为已完成，除非观察确认。如果清洁未成功，在尝试放置前返回清洁阶段。如果所选物品反复清洁失败，将其视为不合适并切换到可能可清洁的候选，而不是循环。将放置确认视为终止条件，而不是清洁步骤。

entries.original: For a heat-then-place goal: locate and take the target object, go to the microwave, open it if closed, perform the heating operation using an observation-confirmed method, keep track of the same object instance, then go to the final destination, open it if needed, put the object there, and confirm placement. Treat heating as an intermediate milestone; the task is complete only after the object is placed at the destination. If the object is already held after acquisition, proceed to the heating stage rather than restarting unnecessarily. Only take the object from the microwave if it was actually placed inside; if heating was done while holding, keep holding and go directly to the destination.
entries.chinese: 对于先加热再放置的目标：定位并 take 目标物品，前往 microwave，如果关闭则 open，使用观察确认的方法执行加热操作，跟踪同一物品实例，然后前往最终目的地，如果需要则 open，将物品 put 到那里，并确认放置。将加热视为中间里程碑；只有物品被 put 到目的地后任务才完成。如果获取后物品已在手中，继续加热阶段，而不是不必要地重新开始。只有当物品确实被放入 microwave 后才从 microwave 中 take 它；如果在手持时完成加热，则保持手持并直接前往目的地。

entries.original: Open the microwave before taking from or using it, and keep it open until heating is confirmed. Use the explicit heat action form heat <object> with microwave <id> rather than generic use <object> or use microwave. Observations conflict on the required heating state: some successful runs heated the object while holding it, while others succeeded by placing the object in an open microwave and then heating. Treat the holding/placement requirement as observation-dependent. If heating while holding returns 'Nothing happens', place the object in the open microwave and retry. If heating with the object inside returns 'Nothing happens', take it out, ensure the microwave is open, and retry while holding it. Do not repeat an identical failing heat command without changing the object’s position or holding state. Only proceed to the destination after an observation confirms the object was heated.
entries.chinese: 在从 microwave 中 take 或使用它之前先 open，并保持打开直到确认加热。使用显式加热动作形式 heat <object> with microwave <id>，而不是通用的 use <object> 或 use microwave。观察结果在所需加热状态上存在冲突：一些成功运行在手持物品时加热，而另一些则通过将物品放入打开的 microwave 然后加热成功。将手持/放置要求视为依赖观察。如果手持加热返回 'Nothing happens'，将物品放入打开的 microwave 并重试。如果物品在里面加热返回 'Nothing happens'，将其取出，确保 microwave 打开，并在手持时重试。不要在未改变物品位置或手持状态的情况下重复相同的失败 heat 命令。只有在观察确认物品已被加热后才前往目的地。

entries.original: Inputs differ on whether cooling requires placing the object in the fridge and taking it out or issuing an explicit cool action while holding it at an open fridge. Use environment feedback as authority: perform or verify cooling explicitly, and do not treat mere containment or brief placement as confirmed cooling. A reliable sequence is: acquire the exact target; go to the fridge; open it; if an explicit cool action is available, issue it while holding the object, otherwise use the available cooling interaction and wait for a cooled-state confirmation; then go to the destination; open it if closed; put the object there; confirm placement. Do not issue a cool action before the object is actually held. Do not add a take-from-fridge step when cooling was done while holding, and do not immediately re-take an object already held; check inventory before re-taking.
entries.chinese: 输入在冷却是否需要将物品放入 fridge 再取出，还是在打开的 fridge 处手持物品发出显式 cool 动作上存在分歧。以环境反馈为准：显式执行或验证冷却，不要将仅仅容纳或短暂放置视为已确认冷却。可靠序列是：获取确切目标；前往 fridge；open 它；如果存在显式 cool 动作，在手持物品时发出它，否则使用可用的冷却交互并等待冷却状态确认；然后前往目的地；如果关闭则 open；将物品 put 到那里；确认放置。不要在物品实际被手持之前发出 cool 动作。如果在手持时完成冷却，不要添加从 fridge 中 take 的步骤，也不要立即重新 take 已手持的物品；在重新 take 前检查库存。

entries.original: Treat a two-item placement goal as two search-and-place cycles. Locate and take one target object, navigate to the destination, open the destination if it is closed, place the object, and confirm the placement before starting the second cycle. Track how many items are placed and which object was already placed; never take an already-placed object again. If both instances are visible on the same surface or receptacle, place the first then return to that same location for the second. Continue until both instances are confirmed placed; do not stop after placing only one. If the final destination is temporarily unavailable, only use a safe recoverable holding location when necessary and move both objects to the final destination afterward.
entries.chinese: 将两物品放置目标视为两个搜索并放置的循环。定位并 take 一个目标物品，导航到目的地，如果目的地关闭则 open，put 物品，并在开始第二个循环前确认放置。跟踪已放置多少物品以及哪个物品已被放置；绝不要再次 take 已放置的物品。如果两个实例都可见于同一表面或容器上，先 put 第一个，然后返回同一位置处理第二个。继续直到两个实例都确认放置；不要只放置一个就停止。如果最终目的地暂时不可用，仅在必要时使用安全可恢复的持有位置，之后将两个物品都移到最终目的地。

entries.original: Failed trajectories show that examine X with desklamp, examine the target, examine desklamp, bare-name use desklamp, use desklamp on X, and use X on desklamp often return 'There's nothing special about X' or 'Nothing happens' and cannot substitute for the observation condition. Merely placing the target on the desk or desklamp without triggering the lamp interaction also leaves the environment goal unmet. The working form is the numbered lamp instance, e.g. 'use desklamp 1'; bare 'use desklamp', 'use lamp', 'use desk 1', and 'open desk 1' all returned Nothing happens before the numbered form succeeded.
entries.chinese: 失败轨迹显示 examine X with desklamp、examine the target、examine desklamp、裸名 use desklamp、use desklamp on X 和 use X on desklamp 通常返回 'There's nothing special about X' 或 'Nothing happens'，不能替代观察条件。仅仅将目标 put 到 desk 或 desklamp 上而不触发台灯交互，也会使环境目标未满足。有效形式是带编号的台灯实例，例如 'use desklamp 1'；裸 'use desklamp'、'use lamp'、'use desk 1' 和 'open desk 1' 在带编号形式成功前都返回 Nothing happens。

entries.original: The environment does not support the desklamp as an examine tool argument, nor bare-name or compound syntax; placement actions alone do not trigger the observation success condition.
entries.chinese: 环境不支持将 desklamp 作为 examine 工具参数，也不支持裸名或复合语法；仅放置动作不会触发观察成功条件。

entries.original: After locating and bringing the target to the lamp's furniture, execute 'use desklamp <id>' with the observed numbered lamp instance. Do not use examine X with desklamp or compound use syntax; if an invalid syntax was tried, verify the lamp instance name and retry with the numbered form rather than repeatedly examining the target or lamp.
entries.chinese: 在定位并将目标带到台灯所属家具后，使用观察到的带编号台灯实例执行 'use desklamp <id>'。不要使用 examine X with desklamp 或复合 use 语法；如果尝试了无效语法，验证台灯实例名称并用带编号形式重试，而不是反复 examine 目标或台灯。

entries.original: A clean action can return no effect when the object is not held, the current location is not a valid cleaning fixture, or the chosen object is not cleanable (e.g., a towel or cloth may not support cleaning at a sinkbasin). Cleaning is reliably supported at a sinkbasin; alternative fixtures such as bathtubbasin or fridge should not be assumed equivalent. Repeated identical attempts waste steps, and attempting to take another object while still holding the failed one produces repeated no-ops.
entries.chinese: 当物品未被手持、当前位置不是有效清洁设施，或所选物品不可清洁时（例如毛巾或布可能不支持在 sinkbasin 清洁），clean 动作可能返回无效果。在 sinkbasin 处可靠支持清洁；不应假定 bathtubbasin 或 fridge 等替代设施等效。重复相同尝试会浪费步数，而在仍持有失败物品时尝试 take 另一个物品会产生重复无操作。

entries.original: The environment validates that the object is held and that cleaning occurs at a compatible fixture; some fixtures or object types do not support cleaning.
entries.chinese: 环境会验证物品是否被手持，以及清洁是否在兼容设施处进行；某些设施或物品类型不支持清洁。

entries.original: Hold the target object, navigate to a sinkbasin, then clean. If no effect, verify the held object and current location; try a different sinkbasin or confirm the object is cleanable. After a failed clean, either try a different cleanable candidate or release the held object at a valid surface before acquiring another. Treat bathtubbasin as unverified and switch to sinkbasin if it fails; do not loop on an invalid fixture.
entries.chinese: 手持目标物品，导航到 sinkbasin，然后 clean。如果无效果，验证手持物品和当前位置；尝试不同的 sinkbasin 或确认物品可清洁。clean 失败后，要么尝试不同的可清洁候选，要么在获取另一个物品前将手持物品释放到有效表面。将 bathtubbasin 视为未验证，如果失败则切换到 sinkbasin；不要在无效设施上循环。

entries.original: Placement can fail when the destination container is closed, has no available space, or is not a valid receptacle; for example, fixtures such as toilets or coffeemachines may reject placement, and repeated put/open/use on a coffeemachine all return 'Nothing happens'. An open action may also return no effect if the container is already open or not openable; in that case proceed to put rather than retrying open.
entries.chinese: 当目的地容器关闭、没有可用空间或不是有效容器时，放置可能失败；例如 toilet 或 coffeemachine 等设施可能拒绝放置，对 coffeemachine 重复 put/open/use 都返回 'Nothing happens'。如果容器已经打开或不可打开，open 动作也可能返回无效果；在这种情况下继续 put，而不是重试 open。

entries.original: Before placing, open a closed destination; if open returns no effect, do not retry it—proceed or reassess. Check for space or availability when possible. If the destination is invalid or put repeatedly has no effect, treat it as invalid and seek an alternative valid destination or report blocked rather than looping.
entries.chinese: 放置前，先打开关闭的目的地；如果 open 没有效果，不要重试——继续或重新评估。尽可能检查空间或可用性。如果目的地无效，或 put 反复没有效果，就将其视为无效，寻找另一个有效目的地或报告受阻，而不是循环。

entries.original: Microwave heating with explicit heat command and observation-driven recovery
entries.chinese: 使用显式 heat 命令进行微波炉加热，并基于观察进行恢复

entries.original: Open the microwave before taking from or using it. Use the explicit heating command form 'heat <object> <id> with microwave <id>' while holding the object at an open microwave; bare 'use <object>' or 'use microwave <id>' are invalid forms that return 'Nothing happens'. If the explicit heat command fails while holding, place the object in the open microwave and retry the explicit heat command. If heating with the object inside fails, take it out, ensure the microwave is open, and retry while holding it. Do not repeat an identical failing heat command without changing the object's position, holding state, or command form.
entries.chinese: 从微波炉取物或使用微波炉前先打开它。在打开的微波炉旁手持物体时，使用显式加热命令形式 'heat <object> <id> with microwave <id>'；裸 'use <object>' 或 'use microwave <id>' 是无效形式，会返回 'Nothing happens'。如果手持时显式 heat 命令失败，将物体放入打开的微波炉并重试显式 heat 命令。如果物体在内部时加热失败，将其取出，确保微波炉打开，并在手持时重试。不要在不改变物体位置、手持状态或命令形式的情况下重复相同的失败 heat 命令。

entries.original: Cooling workflow with explicit cool command and confirmed cool state before placement
entries.chinese: 使用显式 cool 命令并在放置前确认冷却状态的工作流程

entries.original: Use environment feedback as authority and perform cooling explicitly. A reliable sequence is: acquire the exact target; go to the fridge; open it; issue the explicit cool command 'cool <object> <id> with fridge <id>' while holding the object; wait for a cooled-state confirmation; then go to the destination; open it if closed; put the object there; confirm placement. Do not treat mere containment or brief placement in the fridge as confirmed cooling, and do not immediately re-take an object already held; check inventory before re-taking. After a successful cool action while holding the object, the object remains in inventory, so proceed directly to the destination rather than trying to take it from the fridge.
entries.chinese: 以环境反馈为准并显式执行冷却。可靠顺序是：获取确切目标；前往 fridge；打开它；手持物体时发出显式 cool 命令 'cool <object> <id> with fridge <id>'；等待冷却状态确认；然后前往目的地；如果关闭则打开；将物体放在那里；确认放置。不要仅将放入 fridge 或短暂放置视为已确认冷却，也不要立即重新拿取已持有的物体；重新拿取前检查库存。手持物体成功执行 cool 动作后，物体仍在库存中，因此直接前往目的地，而不是尝试从 fridge 中拿取它。

entries.original: Attempting to put an object into, or take an object from, a closed cabinet, drawer, or similar container may produce no effect. Conversely, if the container is already open, an open action returns 'Nothing happens' and should not be retried; proceed to put.
entries.chinese: 尝试将物体放入关闭的柜子、抽屉或类似容器，或从中取出物体，可能没有效果。相反，如果容器已经打开，open 动作会返回 'Nothing happens'，不应重试；继续执行 put。

entries.original: The environment requires the container to be open before its contents can be accessed or modified, and reports no change when opening an already-open container.
entries.chinese: 环境要求容器打开后才能访问或修改其内容，并且打开已打开的容器时会报告无变化。

entries.original: Open the container first with the appropriate open action. If it is already open or open returns no effect, proceed directly to put rather than retrying open; after opening, verify access before taking or placing.
entries.chinese: 先用适当的 open 动作打开容器。如果它已经打开，或 open 没有效果，直接继续执行 put，而不是重试 open；打开后，在拿取或放置前确认可访问。

entries.original: Before placing, open a closed destination; if open returns no effect, treat it as already open or non-openable and proceed directly to put rather than retrying open. Check for space or availability when possible. If the destination is invalid or put repeatedly has no effect, seek an alternative valid destination or report blocked rather than looping.
entries.chinese: 放置前，先打开关闭的目的地；如果 open 没有效果，将其视为已打开或不可打开，并直接继续执行 put，而不是重试 open。尽可能检查空间或可用性。如果目的地无效，或 put 反复没有效果，寻找另一个有效目的地或报告受阻，而不是循环。

entries.original: A put action can produce no effect if it is issued before reaching the destination receptacle, or it can fail without the failure being noticed. Continuing to search for the second item after an unconfirmed first placement can leave the goal unsatisfied. If the destination receptacle rejects placement, treat it as invalid rather than retrying the same put.
entries.chinese: 如果在到达目的地容器之前发出 put 动作，可能没有效果，或者失败未被注意到。在第一次放置未确认后继续寻找第二个物品，可能导致目标未满足。如果目的地容器拒绝放置，将其视为无效，而不是重试相同的 put。

entries.original: Placement requires being at the target container and a successful put must be verified from the observation; otherwise the first item may still be held or not placed. Some named destinations may be invalid or unreachable.
entries.chinese: 放置需要位于目标容器处，并且必须从观察中验证 put 成功；否则第一个物品可能仍被持有或未放置。某些指定目的地可能无效或不可达。

entries.original: Navigate to the destination before placing. After each put, inspect the observation to confirm success. If the put did not succeed, move to the target if needed and retry before starting the next search or placement cycle. If the destination repeatedly rejects placement, reassess whether it is valid and report blocked instead of looping or abandoning the held object.
entries.chinese: 放置前先导航到目的地。每次 put 后，检查观察以确认成功。如果 put 未成功，必要时移动到目标并重试，然后再开始下一轮搜索或放置周期。如果目的地反复拒绝放置，重新评估其是否有效并报告受阻，而不是循环或放弃持有的物体。

entries.original: Open the microwave before taking from or using it, and verify from the observation that it is open before endorsing any heat action. Observations conflict on the required heating state: some successful runs heated the object while holding it, while others succeeded by placing the object in an open microwave and then heating. Treat the holding/placement requirement as observation-dependent. If heating while holding returns 'Nothing happens', the recovery is to place the object into the open microwave, then take it back out and heat while holding—not to keep retrying the identical heat command. If heating with the object inside returns 'Nothing happens', take it out, ensure the microwave is open, and retry while holding it. Do not repeat an identical failing heat command without changing the object’s position or holding state.
entries.chinese: 从微波炉取物或使用微波炉前先打开它，并在认可任何 heat 动作前从观察中确认它已打开。观察在所需加热状态上存在冲突：一些成功运行在手持物体时加热，另一些则通过将物体放入打开的微波炉然后加热成功。将手持/放置要求视为依赖观察。如果手持时加热返回 'Nothing happens'，恢复方法是将物体放入打开的微波炉，然后将其取回并在手持时加热——而不是继续重试相同的 heat 命令。如果物体在内部时加热返回 'Nothing happens'，将其取出，确保微波炉打开，并在手持时重试。不要在不改变物体位置或手持状态的情况下重复相同的失败 heat 命令。

entries.original: After microwave heating returns 'Nothing happens', switching to stoveburners, toasters, or other appliances without evidence can also fail or be blocked, and accepting placement of an unheated object (or a cool action) does not satisfy a hot-object goal. Assumption-based substitution adds failed steps rather than recovering the task.
entries.chinese: 微波炉加热返回 'Nothing happens' 后，在没有证据的情况下改用 stoveburners、toasters 或其他电器也可能失败或被阻止，并且接受未加热物体的放置（或 cool 动作）不能满足热物体目标。基于假设的替换会增加失败步骤，而不是恢复任务。

entries.original: Some appliances may not support heating the target object, some surfaces may be occupied, and support for a given object or appliance is not guaranteed merely because an alternative exists. Endorsing placement without a confirmed heating observation lets the episode fail even though actions were issued.
entries.chinese: 某些电器可能不支持加热目标物体，某些表面可能被占用，并且仅因为存在替代品并不能保证对给定物体或电器的支持。在没有确认加热观察的情况下认可放置，会让回合失败，即使已发出动作。

entries.original: Correct the microwave interaction first: check that it is open, adjust whether the object is held or placed inside, and retry without repeating the identical failing command. Use another appliance only when current observations explicitly show that it supports heating this object and is available; otherwise do not treat stoveburner or toaster as a blind fallback. Do not accept placement or a cool action as a substitute for a confirmed hot state.
entries.chinese: 首先纠正微波炉交互：检查它是否打开，调整物体是手持还是放在内部，并在不重复相同失败命令的情况下重试。仅当当前观察明确显示另一电器支持加热此物体且可用时，才使用它；否则不要将 stoveburner 或 toaster 视为盲目后备。不要接受放置或 cool 动作作为已确认热状态的替代。

entries.original: When the target object is not in the first searched location, continue systematically checking other plausible containers and surfaces such as cabinets, drawers, countertops, dining tables, stoveburners, fridge, sink basin, and coffee machine. Maintain a checked-location record and direct the Executor to unchecked opened containers and visible surfaces, avoiding redundant revisits. Do not declare the task blocked or the object unavailable merely because the first location is empty. After a few empty containers, broaden to open surfaces and other receptacle types rather than exhaustively opening every drawer; for dish-like objects prioritize open surfaces such as diningtable, countertop, and sidetable alongside containers.
entries.chinese: 当目标物体不在第一个搜索位置时，继续系统检查其他可能的容器和表面，如 cabinets、drawers、countertops、dining tables、stoveburners、fridge、sink basin 和 coffee machine。维护已检查位置记录，并引导 Executor 前往未检查的已打开容器和可见表面，避免重复访问。不要仅因为第一个位置为空就宣布任务受阻或物体不可用。在几个空容器后，扩大到开放表面和其他容器类型，而不是穷尽地打开每个抽屉；对于盘状物体，优先考虑 diningtable、countertop 和 sidetable 等开放表面以及容器。

entries.original: Attempts to take a second object, or sometimes to move to another location, while already holding an object can return a no-op. This blocks progress in two-item placement if the held object is not released first. A failed second take while an object is held should be diagnosed as the one-item carry limit, not as the second object being absent.
entries.chinese: 在已持有物体时尝试拿取第二个物体，或有时移动到另一位置，可能返回无操作。如果未先释放持有的物体，这会阻碍双物品放置的进展。持有物体时第二次 take 失败应诊断为单物品携带限制，而不是第二个物体不存在。

entries.original: Before taking the second object or moving to search elsewhere, put the held object into the final destination or into a safe recoverable temporary location. Confirm the hands are empty, then continue. When a take fails while holding an object, attribute it to occupied inventory and place the held object first rather than concluding the target is missing.
entries.chinese: 在拿取第二个物体或移动到别处搜索之前，将持有的物体放入最终目的地或安全的可恢复临时位置。确认双手为空，然后继续。当持有物体时 take 失败，应归因于库存已占用，并先放置持有的物体，而不是断定目标缺失。

entries.original: A put action can produce no effect if it is issued before reaching the destination receptacle, or it can fail without the failure being noticed. When a put into the final destination returns 'Nothing happens', first check whether the Executor is actually at the destination before concluding the receptacle rejects placement; the usual cause is not being at the destination. Continuing to search for the second item after an unconfirmed first placement can leave the goal unsatisfied.
entries.chinese: 如果在到达目的地容器之前发出 put 动作，可能没有效果，或者失败未被注意到。当放入最终目的地的 put 返回 'Nothing happens' 时，在断定容器拒绝放置之前，先检查 Executor 是否确实在目的地；通常原因是不在目的地。在第一次放置未确认后继续寻找第二个物品，可能导致目标未满足。

entries.original: Placement requires being at the target container and a successful put must be verified from the observation; otherwise the first item may still be held or not placed, and misattributing the failure to receptacle type leads to wrong alternative-destination advice.
entries.chinese: 放置需要位于目标容器处，并且必须从观察中确认 put 成功；否则第一个物品可能仍被持有或未放置，而将失败错误归因于容器类型会导致错误的备选目的地建议。

entries.original: Navigate to the destination before placing. After each put, inspect the observation to confirm success. If the put did not succeed, verify current location, move to the target if needed, and retry before starting the next search or placement cycle; do not switch to an alternative receptacle until the destination-location cause is ruled out.
entries.chinese: 放置前先导航到目的地。每次 put 后检查观察以确认成功。如果 put 未成功，核实当前位置，必要时移动到目标处，并在开始下一轮搜索或放置循环前重试；在排除目的地位置原因之前，不要改用备选容器。

entries.original: After several containers have been opened and no target found, repeatedly revisiting locations already confirmed empty can exhaust the action budget and cause failure. When the Executor is stuck holding an object and every put attempt returns 'Nothing happens' across many receptacles, continuing to suggest yet another receptacle is also a loop that wastes the budget.
entries.chinese: 在已打开多个容器且未找到目标后，反复重访已确认空的位置会耗尽动作预算并导致失败。当 Executor 卡在持有物品且在许多容器上每次 put 尝试都返回 'Nothing happens' 时，继续建议又一个容器同样是浪费预算的循环。

entries.original: Searching without tracking checked locations leads to redundant actions, while unchecked opened containers or visible surfaces may still contain the target; and a held object that cannot be placed may indicate an unplaceable object or infeasible goal rather than a wrong receptacle.
entries.chinese: 搜索时不记录已检查位置会导致冗余动作，而未检查的已打开容器或可见表面可能仍含有目标；无法放置的持有物品可能表明物品不可放置或目标不可行，而非容器错误。

entries.original: Maintain a mental or explicit list of checked locations. Prioritize unchecked opened containers and visible surfaces; take a target directly if it is visible. Avoid revisiting a location already confirmed to have no target unless new evidence suggests otherwise. If every put attempt fails across many receptacles, stop suggesting new receptacles and reassess the held object's exact identifier and whether the destination accepts placement, considering the object unplaceable or the goal infeasible rather than looping.
entries.chinese: 维护已检查位置的心理或显式列表。优先检查未检查的已打开容器和可见表面；如果目标可见则直接 take。避免重访已确认无目标的位置，除非有新证据表明并非如此。如果许多容器上每次 put 尝试都失败，停止建议新容器，重新评估持有物品的确切标识符以及目的地是否接受放置，考虑物品不可放置或目标不可行，而不是循环。

entries.original: When a target object's location is unknown, locate it before manipulation by checking open, directly observable surfaces and common holding places first, such as tables, countertops, desks, dressers, shelves, beds, sofas, chairs, and even unusual surfaces like toilets or tvstands. Only then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, and microwaves. Treat the search as a broad multi-location search rather than assuming one named receptacle contains the object; if an early location is empty, broaden to other plausible unchecked locations. If the target or a needed fixture (e.g., a desklamp) is already visible on a surface, go directly to that furniture instead of continuing to search unrelated containers.
entries.chinese: 当目标物品位置未知时，在操作前先定位它：先检查开放、可直接观察的表面和常见存放处，如桌子、台面、书桌、梳妆台、架子、床、沙发、椅子，甚至马桶或 tvstand 等不寻常表面。然后才打开抽屉、柜子、冰箱和微波炉等封闭容器。将搜索视为广泛的多位置搜索，而不是假设某个命名容器包含该物品；如果早期位置为空，则扩大到其他可能的未检查位置。如果目标或所需设施（例如 desklamp）已可见于某表面，直接前往该家具，而不是继续搜索无关容器。

entries.original: When the target object's location is unknown at the start, when the first checked location does not contain it, or when the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface.
entries.chinese: 当目标物品位置在开始时未知、当第一个检查的位置不包含它、或当目标或所需设施已可见于某表面时。

entries.original: Failed searches often repeat the same empty surfaces or failed take attempts, revisit already-confirmed-empty locations, or conclude the object is unavailable before all plausible open surfaces and relevant containers have been checked. A search should maintain a checked-location list and move to a new unchecked plausible location after a failed take or empty look.
entries.chinese: 失败的搜索常常重复相同的空表面或失败的 take 尝试、重访已确认空的位置，或在检查完所有可能的开放表面和相关容器之前就断定物品不可用。搜索应维护已检查位置列表，并在 take 失败或 look 为空后移动到新的未检查可能位置。

entries.original: The search may be treated as an unconstrained sequence without bookkeeping, so empty locations are revisited and some plausible locations are never examined; alternatively the agent may declare blocked after only a subset of locations is checked.
entries.chinese: 搜索可能被当作无记录的无约束序列，导致空位置被重访而某些可能位置从未检查；或者 agent 可能在仅检查了部分位置后就宣布受阻。

entries.original: Record each checked location and its result. After a failed take or empty look, mark that location checked and move to another plausible unchecked location. Do not revisit confirmed empty surfaces unless the environment state changed. Open closed receptacles before treating them as searched and prioritize locations by object type. If the object remains absent after relevant locations are exhausted, report failure rather than continuing indefinitely; but do not declare blocked while plausible unchecked locations remain.
entries.chinese: 记录每个已检查位置及其结果。在 take 失败或 look 为空后，将该位置标记为已检查并移动到另一个可能的未检查位置。除非环境状态改变，不要重访已确认空的表面。在将封闭容器视为已搜索前先打开它们，并按物品类型优先排序位置。如果在相关位置耗尽后物品仍不存在，报告失败而不是无限继续；但在仍有未检查可能位置时不要宣布受阻。

entries.original: Use only supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, open a container before accessing it, and use a fixture with its numbered instance. Refer to exact object and receptacle identifiers from observations, including instance numbers (e.g., take soapbottle 1 from countertop 1); never navigate to a takeable object. Track the specific instance taken so later actions use the same one. Do not use examine, look at, or open on non-container surfaces; open only applies to openable containers. Confirm the object name matches the goal, since similar types (mug vs cup, butterknife vs knife) may not satisfy it. If many containers have been checked without success, reassess visible surfaces and the target description rather than continuing blind exhaustive checks.
entries.chinese: 仅使用支持的动作形式：go to 某位置、从容器 take 物品、将物品 put 到容器中或上、在访问前 open 容器、以及 use 带编号实例的设施。引用观察中的确切物品和容器标识符，包括实例编号（例如 take soapbottle 1 from countertop 1）；绝不要导航到可拿取物品。跟踪所拿取的具体实例，以便后续动作使用同一个。不要对非容器表面使用 examine、look at 或 open；open 仅适用于可打开的容器。确认物品名称与目标匹配，因为相似类型（mug 与 cup、butterknife 与 knife）可能不满足目标。如果已检查许多容器而未成功，重新评估可见表面和目标描述，而不是继续盲目穷举检查。

entries.original: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns 'Nothing happens', do not repeat the same command. Failed attempts can come from being at the wrong location, using an inexact or invalid identifier, targeting a closed or non-openable receptacle, or trying an inaccessible location. Treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and switch to another candidate; treat an already-open container as open and continue rather than reopening it. Repeated no-change results are evidence that the current approach is exhausted.
entries.chinese: 当 go to、open、take、put、use 或 clean 等动作返回 'Nothing happens' 时，不要重复相同命令。失败尝试可能源于位置错误、使用不精确或无效的标识符、针对封闭或不可打开的容器、或尝试不可达位置。将不可达的导航目标视为不可用并切换到另一个候选；将已打开的容器视为已打开并继续，而不是重新打开它。反复无变化的结果是当前方法已耗尽的证据。

entries.original: For tasks that require an object to be found and then manipulated, cleaned, heated, cooled, examined, or placed, split the task into an acquisition phase and an operation phase. The acquisition phase ends only when the target object is actually held, not merely seen or when a container is opened. Signal handoff only after the take observation confirms holding the object, and note any remaining operation (cleaning, heating, cooling, placement) for the next role. The operation phase ends only when the environment observation confirms the required final state.
entries.chinese: 对于需要先找到物品再操作、清洁、加热、冷却、检查或放置的任务，将任务分为获取阶段和操作阶段。获取阶段仅在目标物品实际被持有时结束，而不仅仅是看到或打开容器时。仅在 take 观察确认持有物品后才发出交接信号，并记录下一角色所需的任何剩余操作（清洁、加热、冷却、放置）。操作阶段仅在环境观察确认所需最终状态时结束。

entries.original: Searching for the target object should prioritize plausible locations and avoid opening every remaining container indefinitely or declaring blocked prematurely. If the object is not found after checking a reasonable set of likely locations, reassess or report blocked rather than continuing a step-consuming loop; conversely, do not stop after only one or two empty locations while many plausible ones remain.
entries.chinese: 搜索目标物品应优先考虑可能位置，避免无限打开每个剩余容器或过早宣布受阻。如果在检查了一组合理的可能位置后仍未找到物品，重新评估或报告受阻，而不是继续消耗步骤的循环；反之，在仍有许多可能位置时不要仅在一两个空位置后就停止。

entries.original: Item locations follow some regularities, but unusual placement or impossible tasks can occur; unbounded search wastes steps and can cause timeout or failure, while premature blocking misses findable objects.
entries.chinese: 物品位置遵循一定规律，但可能出现不寻常放置或不可能任务；无界搜索浪费步骤并可能导致超时或失败，而过早受阻会错过可找到的物品。

entries.original: Prioritize likely locations by object type: food-related items in fridge; dishes or utensils in countertop, cabinet, or drawer; cleaning supplies near sinkbasin, countertop, or shelf. Track checked locations and avoid revisiting confirmed-empty ones. After a few likely locations fail, consider unusual placement or impossibility, then reassess or report blocked rather than exhaustively opening all containers or stopping too early.
entries.chinese: 按物品类型优先考虑可能位置：食物相关物品在 fridge；餐具或器皿在 countertop、cabinet 或 drawer；清洁用品在 sinkbasin、countertop 或 shelf 附近。跟踪已检查位置，避免重访已确认空的位置。在几个可能位置失败后，考虑不寻常放置或不可能性，然后重新评估或报告受阻，而不是穷举打开所有容器或过早停止。

entries.original: When the target object is not in the first searched location, continue systematically checking other plausible containers and surfaces such as cabinets, drawers, countertops, fridge, dining table, sink basin, coffee machine, and stoveburners. Do not declare the task blocked or the object unavailable merely because the first location is empty. Track checked locations and avoid revisiting confirmed-empty surfaces; after a reasonable broad search, reassess rather than opening every remaining container.
entries.chinese: 当目标物品不在第一个搜索位置时，继续系统检查其他可能的容器和表面，如 cabinets、drawers、countertops、fridge、dining table、sink basin、coffee machine 和 stoveburners。不要仅因第一个位置为空就宣布任务受阻或物品不可用。跟踪已检查位置，避免重访已确认空的表面；在合理的广泛搜索后，重新评估而不是打开每个剩余容器。

entries.original: Check a few high-probability locations first, including the fridge, countertops, dining table, cabinets, drawers, and shelves. Open containers as needed and track visited locations to avoid redundant loops. If the target is not found after a reasonable broad search, reassess the goal or whether the object may be absent rather than continuing through every unrelated receptacle. Do not repeat an identical broad search after all obvious receptacles have been exhausted; report or escalate early when feasibility is doubtful. Do not declare blocked after only opening the fridge while other plausible locations remain unchecked.
entries.chinese: 先检查几个高概率位置，包括 fridge、countertops、dining table、cabinets、drawers 和 shelves。按需打开容器并跟踪已访问位置以避免冗余循环。如果在合理的广泛搜索后仍未找到目标，重新评估目标或物品是否可能不存在，而不是继续检查每个无关容器。在所有明显容器耗尽后不要重复相同的广泛搜索；当可行性存疑时尽早报告或升级。不要仅在打开 fridge 而其他可能位置仍未检查后就宣布受阻。

entries.original: When target objects are not immediately visible, search broadly instead of checking only one receptacle type. Inspect visible surfaces such as counters, tables, shelves, sofas, and similar open surfaces first, then check closed containers such as cabinets and drawers, opening them before inspecting or taking from inside. Continue across multiple location types until the required number of instances is found or a checked-location record shows no remaining unchecked likely locations. Do not conclude the task is blocked prematurely, and treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and move to another candidate.
entries.chinese: 当目标物品不立即可见时，广泛搜索而不是只检查一种容器类型。先检查可见表面，如 counters、tables、shelves、sofas 及类似开放表面，然后检查 cabinets 和 drawers 等封闭容器，在检查或从内部 take 前先打开它们。继续跨多种位置类型，直到找到所需数量的实例，或已检查位置记录显示没有剩余未检查的可能位置。不要过早断定任务受阻，并将不可达的导航目标视为不可用并转向另一个候选。

entries.original: After several containers have been opened and no target found, repeatedly revisiting locations already confirmed empty, or re-taking an already-placed instance, can exhaust the action budget and cause failure.
entries.chinese: 在已打开多个容器且未找到目标后，反复重访已确认空的位置，或重新 take 已放置的实例，会耗尽动作预算并导致失败。

entries.original: Searching without tracking checked locations leads to redundant actions, while unchecked opened containers or visible surfaces may still contain the target; the agent may also lose track of which instance was already placed.
entries.chinese: 不记录已检查位置而搜索会导致重复动作，而未检查的已打开容器或可见表面仍可能含有目标；智能体也可能忘记哪个实例已被放置。

entries.original: Maintain a mental or explicit list of checked locations and placed instances. Prioritize unchecked opened containers and visible surfaces; take a target directly if it is visible. Avoid revisiting a location already confirmed to have no target or re-taking an already-placed object unless new evidence suggests otherwise.
entries.chinese: 维护一份已检查位置和已放置实例的心理或显式列表。优先检查未检查的已打开容器和可见表面；若目标可见则直接 take。避免重访已确认无目标的位置，或重新 take 已放置的对象，除非有新证据表明并非如此。

entries.original: Search observable surfaces first, then broaden to closed containers
entries.chinese: 先搜索可观察表面，再扩大到关闭的容器

entries.original: When the target object's location is unknown, locate it before manipulation by checking open, directly observable surfaces and common holding places first: tables, countertops, desks, dressers, shelves, beds, sofas, chairs, and other plausible visible surfaces such as toilets or TV stands when they could hold the target. Only then open closed containers such as drawers, cabinets, fridges, microwaves, and similar receptacles. Treat search as a broad multi-location search rather than assuming one named receptacle contains the object. If an early location is empty, broaden to other plausible unchecked locations. If the target or a required fixture is already visible on a surface, go directly to that furniture instead of continuing unrelated container checks.
entries.chinese: 当目标对象位置未知时，在操作前先定位它：先检查开放、可直接观察的表面和常见存放处：桌子、台面、书桌、梳妆台、架子、床、沙发、椅子，以及其他可能存放目标的合理可见表面，如马桶或电视柜。然后才打开关闭的容器，如抽屉、柜子、冰箱、微波炉及类似容器。将搜索视为广泛的多位置搜索，而非假定某个命名容器含有该对象。若早期位置为空，扩大到其他合理的未检查位置。若目标或所需设施已可见于某表面，直接前往该家具，而非继续无关的容器检查。

entries.original: Search may be treated as an unconstrained sequence without bookkeeping, so empty locations are revisited and some plausible locations are never examined; alternatively, failure may be declared after only a subset of locations is checked.
entries.chinese: 搜索可能被视为无约束序列而不做记录，导致空位置被重访且某些合理位置从未检查；或者仅检查部分位置后就宣告失败。

entries.original: Open closed containers before taking or placing and verify destination openability
entries.chinese: 在 take 或 put 前打开关闭的容器，并验证目的地的可打开性

entries.original: Position at the object's receptacle before take and at the destination before put
entries.chinese: 在 take 前定位到对象所在容器，在 put 前定位到目的地

entries.original: A take action succeeds only when the actor is at the receptacle where the object is present, and a put action succeeds only when the actor is at the destination. When retrieving, first locate the object and position at its receptacle before taking. Once the target is held, travel directly to the specified destination and place it without unnecessary intermediate steps; if a put fails, verify current location and navigate to the destination before retrying.
entries.chinese: 只有当行动者位于对象所在容器时 take 动作才成功，只有当行动者位于目的地时 put 动作才成功。取物时，先定位对象并定位到其容器再 take。一旦持有目标，直接前往指定目的地并放置，不做不必要的中间步骤；若 put 失败，验证当前位置并导航到目的地后重试。

entries.original: Use supported action forms, exact identifiers, and matching object instances
entries.chinese: 使用受支持的动作形式、精确标识符和匹配的对象实例

entries.original: Use only supported action forms: go to a location, take an object from a receptacle, put an object in or on a receptacle, open a container before accessing it, and use a fixture with its numbered instance when applicable. Refer to exact object and receptacle identifiers from observations, including instance numbers, and track the specific instance taken so later actions use the same one. Prefer navigating to locations, furniture, or receptacles rather than to a takeable object when the action form requires it. Do not use examine, look at, or open on non-container surfaces; open only applies to openable containers. Before taking or transforming, confirm the object name matches the goal, because similar types may not satisfy it. If many containers have been checked without success, reassess visible surfaces and the target description rather than continuing blind exhaustive checks.
entries.chinese: 仅使用受支持的动作形式：go to 某位置、从容器 take 对象、将对象 put 到容器中或上、在访问容器前 open 它，以及在适用时 use 带编号实例的设施。引用观察中的精确对象和容器标识符，包括实例编号，并跟踪所 take 的特定实例，以便后续动作使用同一实例。当动作形式要求时，优先导航到位置、家具或容器，而非可 take 的对象。不要对非容器表面使用 examine、look at 或 open；open 仅适用于可打开的容器。在 take 或转换前，确认对象名称与目标匹配，因为相似类型可能不满足目标。若已检查许多容器仍无成功，重新评估可见表面和目标描述，而非继续盲目穷举检查。

entries.original: When an action such as go to, open, take, put, use, or clean returns no change, do not repeat the same command. Failed attempts can come from being at the wrong location, using an inexact or invalid identifier, targeting a closed or non-openable receptacle, or trying an inaccessible location. Treat an unreachable navigation target as unavailable and switch to another candidate; treat an already-open container as open and continue rather than reopening it. Repeated no-change results are evidence that the current approach is exhausted.
entries.chinese: 当 go to、open、take、put、use 或 clean 等动作返回无变化时，不要重复同一命令。失败尝试可能源于位置错误、使用不精确或无效的标识符、针对关闭或不可打开的容器，或尝试不可达位置。将不可达的导航目标视为不可用并切换到其他候选；将已打开的容器视为已打开并继续，而非重新打开。重复的无变化结果是当前方法已穷尽的证据。

entries.original: Separate acquisition from operation with observable completion conditions
entries.chinese: 用可观察的完成条件将获取与操作分离

entries.original: For tasks that require an object to be found and then manipulated, cleaned, heated, cooled, examined, or placed, split the task into an acquisition phase and an operation phase. The acquisition phase ends only when the target object is actually held, not merely seen and not merely because a container was opened. The operation phase ends only when the environment observation confirms the required final state, such as the object being at the destination, cleaned, heated, or cooled. Begin placement only after acquisition is confirmed by holding the target object. If a subsequent phase or handoff follows, report acquisition only after the take observation confirms holding and note any remaining operation.
entries.chinese: 对于需要先找到对象再操作、清洁、加热、冷却、检查或放置的任务，将任务分为获取阶段和操作阶段。获取阶段仅在目标对象实际被持有时结束，而非仅被看到，也非仅因打开了容器。操作阶段仅在环境观察确认所需最终状态时结束，如对象位于目的地、已清洁、已加热或已冷却。仅在持有目标对象确认获取后才开始放置。若后续有阶段或交接，仅在 take 观察确认持有后才报告获取，并注明任何剩余操作。

entries.original: An action may be assumed successful without checking feedback, failure may be declared after a successful sequence, or an unnecessary verification step may be added after success, causing loops.
entries.chinese: 可能假定动作成功而不检查反馈，可能在成功序列后宣告失败，或在成功后添加不必要的验证步骤，导致循环。

entries.original: For a simple pick-and-place goal, decompose the task into two ordered subtasks: first locate and take the target object, then move to the specified destination and put the object down.
entries.chinese: 对于简单的拾取放置目标，将任务分解为两个有序子任务：先定位并 take 目标对象，再移动到指定目的地并 put 下对象。

entries.original: Clean-then-place sequence with verified cleaning
entries.chinese: 先清洁后放置的序列，并验证清洁

entries.original: For a goal requiring a clean object to be placed, use separate stages: locate and acquire the named target; bring it to a compatible cleaning fixture, preferring a sinkbasin; clean it; verify from the observation that cleaning succeeded; then go to the destination, open it if closed, and place the object. Do not place before cleaning, and do not mark cleaning complete without confirming evidence. If cleaning did not succeed, return to the cleaning stage before placement. If transfer or handoff occurs after acquisition, record that cleaning is still required. Treat successful placement as the terminal condition.
entries.chinese: 对于需要放置清洁对象的目标，使用独立阶段：定位并获取指定目标；将其带到兼容的清洁设施，优先 sinkbasin；清洁它；从观察验证清洁成功；然后前往目的地，若关闭则 open，并放置对象。不要在清洁前放置，也不要在无确认证据时标记清洁完成。若清洁未成功，在放置前返回清洁阶段。若获取后发生转移或交接，记录仍需清洁。将成功放置视为终止条件。

entries.original: A clean action may produce no effect when the target is not held, the current location is not a valid cleaning fixture, or the object is unsuitable. Cleaning is reliably supported at a sinkbasin in observations; alternatives such as bathtubbasin or fridge should not be assumed equivalent. Repeated identical clean attempts waste steps. Trying to take another object while still holding the failed object may also produce repeated no-ops.
entries.chinese: 当目标未被持有、当前位置不是有效清洁设施或对象不适用时，clean 动作可能无效果。观察中 sinkbasin 可靠支持清洁；bathtubbasin 或 fridge 等替代品不应假定等价。重复相同的 clean 尝试浪费步骤。在仍持有失败对象时尝试 take 另一对象也可能产生重复无操作。

entries.original: The environment appears to validate that the object is held and that cleaning occurs at a compatible fixture; not every fixture or object supports cleaning.
entries.chinese: 环境似乎验证对象被持有且清洁发生在兼容设施；并非每个设施或对象都支持清洁。

entries.original: Hold the target, navigate to a sinkbasin, then clean. If no effect, verify the held object and current location; try a different sinkbasin or confirm the object is cleanable. Treat bathtubbasin as unverified and switch to sinkbasin if it fails. After a failed clean, either try a different cleanable candidate after releasing the held object at a valid surface or report the object as not cleanable; do not loop on the same action.
entries.chinese: 持有目标，导航到 sinkbasin，然后 clean。若无效果，验证持有的对象和当前位置；尝试不同的 sinkbasin 或确认对象可清洁。将 bathtubbasin 视为未验证，若失败则切换到 sinkbasin。clean 失败后，要么在有效表面释放持有的对象后尝试其他可清洁候选，要么报告对象不可清洁；不要在同一动作上循环。

entries.original: Some objects, such as towels or cloth, may not support the clean action at a sinkbasin; repeated clean attempts can keep failing. This may mean the object type is not cleanable or the selected object is not the intended cleanable item.
entries.chinese: 某些物体（如毛巾或布）可能不支持在 sinkbasin 处执行 clean 动作；反复尝试 clean 可能持续失败。这可能意味着该物体类型不可清洁，或所选物体并非预期的可清洁物品。

entries.original: Not every object type supports cleaning, and the chosen item may not be the task's intended cleanable target.
entries.chinese: 并非所有物体类型都支持清洁，所选物品可能不是任务预期的可清洁目标。

entries.original: Before committing to an object, choose a likely cleanable candidate. If clean returns no effect after confirming the fixture and that the object is held, stop repeating clean; try another candidate or report that the object is not cleanable.
entries.chinese: 在确定某个物体之前，先选择一个可能可清洁的候选。如果确认了固定设施且物体已被持有后 clean 仍无效果，就停止重复 clean；尝试另一个候选，或报告该物体不可清洁。

entries.original: Placement can fail when the destination container is closed, has no available space, or is not a valid receptacle. Some fixtures, such as toilets or coffeemachines, may reject placement; repeated put/open/use on a coffeemachine can return no effect. An open action may also return no effect when the container is already open or not openable.
entries.chinese: 当目标容器已关闭、没有可用空间或不是有效容器时，放置可能失败。某些固定设施（如 toilets 或 coffeemachines）可能拒绝放置；对 coffeemachine 反复执行 put/open/use 可能无效果。当容器已经打开或无法打开时，open 动作也可能无效果。

entries.original: Containers may require opening or have capacity limits, and some fixtures are not valid placement targets; repeating put or open without changing conditions can waste steps.
entries.chinese: 容器可能需要打开或有容量限制，某些固定设施不是有效的放置目标；在不改变条件的情况下重复 put 或 open 会浪费步骤。

entries.original: Before placing, open a closed destination. If open returns no effect, do not retry it; treat it as already open or non-openable and proceed or reassess. Check space or availability when possible. If the destination is invalid or put repeatedly has no effect, seek an alternative valid destination or report blocked rather than looping.
entries.chinese: 放置前，先打开已关闭的目标容器。如果 open 无效果，不要重试；将其视为已打开或无法打开，然后继续或重新评估。尽可能检查空间或可用性。如果目标无效或 put 反复无效果，寻找另一个有效目标或报告受阻，而不是循环。

entries.original: Goals specify an object type. Similar alternatives such as mug for cup, pan for pot, or butterknife for knife should not be silently substituted. A close synonym may be used only if the exact object is unavailable and the environment or observation explicitly treats it as equivalent, or the goal permits it; otherwise continue searching or report the mismatch. If the destination already contains a similar object, still acquire, clean, and place the correct target rather than swapping.
entries.chinese: 目标指定的是物体类型。相似替代品（如用 mug 代替 cup、用 pan 代替 pot、用 butterknife 代替 knife）不应被悄悄替换。只有在确切物体不可用且环境或观察明确将其视为等价，或目标允许时，才可使用近义词；否则继续搜索或报告不匹配。如果目标容器中已含有相似物体，仍应获取、清洁并放置正确的目标物体，而不是替换。

entries.original: Generalizing categories can cause taking the wrong item and failing the task, while exact-name matching may miss an accepted synonym; equivalence must be confirmed rather than assumed.
entries.chinese: 泛化类别可能导致拿错物品并导致任务失败，而精确名称匹配可能错过可接受的同义词；等价性必须被确认，而不是假设。

entries.original: Search first for the exact named type. If not found, do not swap in a different type by default; use only a confirmed equivalent. Confirm equivalence through explicit environmental or observational evidence or goal permission before substituting.
entries.chinese: 首先搜索确切命名的类型。如果找不到，默认不要换成其他类型；只使用已确认的等价物。在替换前，通过明确的环境或观察证据或目标许可来确认等价性。

entries.original: Search should prioritize plausible locations but avoid opening every remaining container indefinitely or declaring blocked prematurely. Track checked locations and avoid revisiting confirmed-empty ones. After a reasonable set of likely locations has been checked—not merely one or two when many plausible ones remain—consider unusual placement or impossibility, then reassess or report blocked.
entries.chinese: 搜索应优先考虑可能的位置，但避免无限期打开每个剩余容器或过早宣布受阻。记录已检查的位置，避免重访已确认空的位置。在检查了一组合理的可能位置后——当还有许多可能位置时，不应只检查一两个——考虑不寻常的放置或不可能性，然后重新评估或报告受阻。

entries.original: Item locations may follow regularities, but unusual placement or impossible tasks can occur; unbounded search wastes steps and can cause timeout, while stopping too early can miss findable objects.
entries.chinese: 物品位置可能遵循规律，但也可能出现不寻常的放置或不可能的任务；无界搜索会浪费步骤并可能导致超时，而过早停止可能错过可找到的物体。

entries.original: Prioritize likely locations by object type: food-related items in fridge; dishes or utensils in countertop, cabinet, or drawer; cleaning supplies near sinkbasin, countertop, or shelf. Keep a record of checked locations. After several likely locations fail, consider unusual placement or impossibility and reassess or report blocked rather than exhaustively opening all containers or stopping after only a couple of empty locations.
entries.chinese: 按物体类型优先考虑可能的位置：食物相关物品在 fridge；餐具或器皿在 countertop、cabinet 或 drawer；清洁用品在 sinkbasin、countertop 或 shelf 附近。记录已检查的位置。在几个可能位置失败后，考虑不寻常的放置或不可能性，并重新评估或报告受阻，而不是穷举打开所有容器或只在几个空位置后就停止。

entries.original: Cool an object and confirm its state before placement
entries.chinese: 冷却物体并在放置前确认其状态

entries.original: Use environment feedback as authority. Acquire the exact target; go to the fridge and open it; while holding the target at the open fridge, use the available cooling interaction. If an explicit cool action is available, issue it for the target and fridge; otherwise use the available cooling interaction. Wait for a cooled-state confirmation before leaving. Then go to the destination, open it if closed, put the object there, and confirm placement. Do not treat mere containment, brief placement, or a fridge round-trip as confirmed cooling. Do not re-take an object already held; check inventory first. After successful cooling while holding, proceed directly to the destination rather than adding a take-from-fridge step.
entries.chinese: 以环境反馈为准。获取确切目标；前往 fridge 并打开它；在持有目标且位于打开的 fridge 处时，使用可用的冷却交互。如果有显式的 cool 动作可用，对目标和 fridge 发出该动作；否则使用可用的冷却交互。在离开前等待冷却状态确认。然后前往目标容器，如果已关闭则打开，将物体放在那里，并确认放置。不要将仅仅容纳、短暂放置或往返 fridge 视为已确认冷却。不要重新拿取已持有的物体；先检查库存。在持有物体成功冷却后，直接前往目标容器，而不是增加从 fridge 拿取的步骤。

entries.original: An object found in the fridge, or briefly placed into it, may not be in the required cooled state. Cooling should be performed or verified explicitly before the object is taken to the destination.
entries.chinese: 在 fridge 中找到的物体，或短暂放入其中的物体，可能不处于所需的冷却状态。在将物体带到目标容器之前，应显式执行或验证冷却。

entries.original: Storage location or containment can be mistaken for temperature state, and a fridge round-trip can be assumed to be sufficient cooling. The environment may change temperature only through an explicit cooling interaction.
entries.chinese: 存储位置或容纳可能被误认为温度状态，往返 fridge 可能被假定为足够的冷却。环境可能仅通过显式冷却交互改变温度。

entries.original: After opening the fridge and holding the target, use the available cool interaction and wait for a cooled-state confirmation. Do not immediately retrieve an object just placed in the fridge and treat it as cooled. If no cooled-state confirmation appears, do not assume success; retry or report the unresolved state through the available feedback channel.
entries.chinese: 打开 fridge 并持有目标后，使用可用的 cool 交互并等待冷却状态确认。不要立即取回刚放入 fridge 的物体并视为已冷却。如果没有出现冷却状态确认，不要假设成功；重试或通过可用反馈渠道报告未解决状态。

entries.original: Bounded search with early feasibility reassessment
entries.chinese: 有界搜索并尽早重新评估可行性

entries.original: Search a few high-probability locations first, such as the fridge, countertops, stove burners, dining table, cabinets, drawers, and shelves. Open containers as needed and track visited locations to avoid redundant loops. If the target is not in the fridge, continue a bounded systematic search across other plausible surfaces and containers rather than declaring failure after only opening the fridge. If the target is found on an accessible surface, take it directly and proceed. If it is not found after a reasonable broad search, reassess goal feasibility or possible absence rather than searching every unrelated receptacle. Do not repeat an identical broad search after obvious receptacles are exhausted; raise uncertainty early when feasibility is doubtful.
entries.chinese: 先搜索几个高概率位置，如 fridge、countertops、stove burners、dining table、cabinets、drawers 和 shelves。按需打开容器并记录已访问位置，避免冗余循环。如果目标不在 fridge 中，继续在其他可能表面和容器中进行有界系统搜索，而不是只打开 fridge 后就宣布失败。如果目标在可访问表面上找到，直接拿取并继续。如果在合理的广泛搜索后仍未找到，重新评估目标可行性或可能缺失，而不是搜索每个不相关的容器。在明显容器耗尽后，不要重复相同的广泛搜索；当可行性存疑时尽早提出不确定性。

entries.original: Placing the object directly without cooling, or stopping after opening the fridge or cooling the object without final placement, leaves the goal incomplete. The task requires both a cooled object and placement at the specified destination.
entries.chinese: 未经冷却直接放置物体，或在打开 fridge 或冷却物体后停止而未最终放置，都会使目标未完成。任务要求物体已冷却并放置在指定目标容器。

entries.original: The goal can be misread as simple placement, or cooling can be treated as the whole mission. Declaring completion after a partial step also causes failure.
entries.chinese: 目标可能被误读为简单放置，或者冷却可能被当作整个任务。在部分步骤后就宣布完成也会导致失败。

entries.original: Treat cooling and final placement as separate checkpoints. Include an explicit cooling step before placement when a cool object is required, then continue to the destination and place the object. Do not declare success until both the cooled state and destination placement have been confirmed.
entries.chinese: 将冷却和最终放置视为独立的检查点。当需要冷却物体时，在放置前加入明确的冷却步骤，然后继续前往目的地并放置物体。在确认冷却状态和目的地放置都已完成之前，不要宣布成功。

entries.original: Two-item sequential placement with per-item verification and placed-item tracking
entries.chinese: 两件物品的顺序放置，逐件验证并跟踪已放置物品

entries.original: Treat a two-item placement goal as two search-and-place cycles. For each cycle: locate and take one target object, navigate to the destination, open it if closed, place the object, and verify the placement from the observation before starting the next cycle. Track how many items are placed and which item was already placed; never take an already-placed item again. If a second take fails while an object is held, place the held object at the destination before returning for the second. If both instances are visible on the same surface or receptacle, place the first and then return to that same location for the second. If the final destination is temporarily unavailable, use only a safe recoverable holding location when necessary, then move both objects to the final destination afterward. Treat each placement as a checkpoint, not task completion.
entries.chinese: 将两件物品的放置目标视为两个搜索-放置循环。每个循环：定位并 take 一个目标物体，导航到目的地，若关闭则 open 它，put 该物体，并从观察中验证放置，然后再开始下一个循环。跟踪已放置了多少物品以及哪个物品已经放置；绝不要再次 take 已放置的物品。如果在持有物体时第二次 take 失败，先将持有的物体 put 到目的地，再返回取第二个。如果两个实例都可见于同一表面或容器上，先放置第一个，然后返回同一位置取第二个。如果最终目的地暂时不可用，仅在必要时使用安全的可恢复暂存位置，之后再将两个物体移到最终目的地。将每次放置视为检查点，而非任务完成。

entries.original: Systematic broad search with checked-location tracking
entries.chinese: 系统性的广泛搜索，并跟踪已检查位置

entries.original: When target objects are not immediately visible, search broadly rather than checking only one receptacle type. Inspect visible open surfaces such as counters, tables, shelves, sofas, and similar surfaces first, then check closed containers such as cabinets and drawers, opening them before inspecting or taking from inside. Continue across multiple location types until the required number of instances is found or a checked-location record shows no remaining unchecked likely locations. If both target instances are visible on the same surface, take one, place it, then return to that same surface for the second rather than wandering to unrelated containers. Treat an unreachable or no-change navigation target as unavailable and move to another candidate. Reassess feasibility after likely locations are exhausted, but do not conclude the task is blocked prematurely.
entries.chinese: 当目标物体不立即可见时，应广泛搜索，而不是只检查一种容器类型。先检查可见的开放表面，如台面、桌子、架子、沙发及类似表面，然后检查关闭的容器，如柜子和抽屉，在检查或从内部 take 之前先 open 它们。继续跨多个位置类型搜索，直到找到所需数量的实例，或已检查位置记录显示没有剩余未检查的可能位置。如果两个目标实例都可见于同一表面，take 一个，put 它，然后返回同一表面取第二个，而不是游荡到无关容器。将不可达或无变化的导航目标视为不可用，并转向另一个候选。在可能位置耗尽后重新评估可行性，但不要过早断定任务受阻。

entries.original: Attempts to take a second object, or sometimes to move to another location, while already holding an object can return no effect. This blocks progress in two-item placement if the held object is not released first. A failed second take while an object is held should be diagnosed as the one-item carry limit, not as the second object being absent.
entries.chinese: 在已经持有物体时尝试 take 第二个物体，或有时尝试移动到另一个位置，可能返回无效果。如果未先释放持有的物体，这会阻碍两件物品放置的进展。在持有物体时第二次 take 失败应诊断为单件携带限制，而不是第二个物体不存在。

entries.original: A put action can produce no effect if issued before reaching the destination receptacle, or it can fail without the failure being noticed. Continuing to search for the second item after an unconfirmed first placement can leave the goal unsatisfied. When a put returns no change, first verify that the actor is actually at the destination before concluding the receptacle rejects placement. If the destination repeatedly rejects placement after the location cause is ruled out, reassess whether it is valid and report blocked rather than looping or abandoning the held object.
entries.chinese: 如果在到达目的地容器之前发出 put 动作，可能产生无效果，或者可能失败而未被察觉。在第一次放置未确认后继续搜索第二个物品，可能导致目标未满足。当 put 返回无变化时，首先验证行动者确实在目的地，再断定容器拒绝放置。如果排除位置原因后目的地仍反复拒绝放置，重新评估其是否有效，并报告受阻，而不是循环或丢弃持有的物体。

entries.original: Placement requires being at the target container, and a successful put must be verified from the observation; otherwise the first item may still be held or not placed. Misattributing a location failure to receptacle type can lead to wrong alternative-destination actions, while some named destinations may be invalid or unreachable.
entries.chinese: 放置需要位于目标容器处，成功的 put 必须从观察中验证；否则第一个物品可能仍被持有或未放置。将位置失败误归因于容器类型可能导致错误的替代目的地动作，而某些指定目的地可能无效或不可达。

entries.original: Navigate to the destination before placing. After each put, inspect the observation to confirm success. If the put did not succeed, verify the current location, move to the target if needed, and retry before starting the next search or placement cycle. Do not switch to an alternative receptacle until the destination-location cause has been ruled out; if repeated rejection continues, reassess validity and report blocked.
entries.chinese: 在放置前导航到目的地。每次 put 后，检查观察以确认成功。如果 put 未成功，验证当前位置，必要时移动到目标，并在开始下一个搜索或放置循环前重试。在排除目的地位置原因之前，不要切换到替代容器；如果反复拒绝持续，重新评估有效性并报告受阻。

entries.original: Attempting to put an object into, or take an object from, a closed cabinet, drawer, or similar container may produce no effect. Issuing open on an already-open container may also return no change and should not be retried. Issuing open on a container while standing at its parent furniture may return no change; the actor must navigate to the container itself first.
entries.chinese: 尝试将物体 put 进关闭的柜子、抽屉或类似容器，或从其中 take 物体，可能产生无效果。对已经打开的容器发出 open 也可能返回无变化，不应重试。站在容器的父家具处对容器发出 open 可能返回无变化；行动者必须先导航到容器本身。

entries.original: The environment requires the container to be open before its contents can be accessed or modified, reports no change when opening an already-open container, and validates open actions against the actor's current location being the container rather than its parent furniture.
entries.chinese: 环境要求容器打开后才能访问或修改其内容，打开已打开的容器时报告无变化，并且验证 open 动作时依据行动者当前位置是否为容器本身，而非其父家具。

entries.original: Navigate to the container itself, then open it with the appropriate open action. If it is already open, or if opening returns no change, proceed to take or place rather than retrying open. After opening, verify access before taking or placing. Do not issue open on a container from its parent furniture.
entries.chinese: 导航到容器本身，然后用适当的 open 动作打开它。如果它已经打开，或 open 返回无变化，则继续 take 或 put，而不是重试 open。打开后，在 take 或 put 之前验证可访问性。不要从父家具处对容器发出 open。

entries.original: After several containers have been opened and no target found, repeatedly revisiting locations already confirmed empty, re-taking an already-placed instance, repeating a no-change navigation, or trying yet another receptacle after many failed put attempts can exhaust the action budget and cause failure. A held object whose put attempts fail across many receptacles may indicate an unplaceable object or an infeasible goal rather than a wrong receptacle.
entries.chinese: 在打开多个容器且未找到目标后，反复重访已确认空的位置、重新 take 已放置的实例、重复无变化的导航，或在多次 put 失败后尝试又一个容器，可能耗尽动作预算并导致失败。一个持有的物体在多个容器上 put 尝试均失败，可能表明该物体不可放置或目标不可行，而不是容器错误。

entries.original: Searching without tracking checked locations and placed instances leads to redundant actions, while unchecked opened containers or visible surfaces may still contain the target. A no-change navigation indicates the target location is unreachable or invalid, so retrying it cannot help.
entries.chinese: 搜索时不跟踪已检查位置和已放置实例会导致冗余动作，而未检查的已打开容器或可见表面可能仍包含目标。无变化的导航表明目标位置不可达或无效，因此重试无济于事。

entries.original: Maintain a list of checked locations and placed instances. Prioritize unchecked opened containers and visible surfaces; take a target directly if it is visible. Avoid revisiting a location confirmed to have no target or re-taking an already-placed object unless new evidence suggests otherwise. After one no-change navigation, choose a different unchecked location. If every put attempt fails across many receptacles, stop suggesting new receptacles and reassess the held object's exact identifier and whether the destination accepts placement, considering the object unplaceable or the goal infeasible.
entries.chinese: 维护已检查位置和已放置实例的列表。优先检查未检查的已打开容器和可见表面；如果目标可见，直接 take 它。避免重访已确认无目标的位置或重新 take 已放置的物体，除非有新证据表明并非如此。在一次无变化导航后，选择另一个未检查位置。如果所有 put 尝试在多个容器上均失败，停止建议新容器，重新评估持有物体的确切标识符以及目的地是否接受放置，考虑该物体不可放置或目标不可行。

entries.original: Repeatedly declaring a subtask complete without executing the required next action can trigger a loop guard and terminate the episode before the two items are placed. Re-taking an already-placed item and re-placing it at a different instance of the destination can also trigger a guard.
entries.chinese: 反复宣布子任务完成而不执行所需的下一步动作，可能触发循环保护并在两件物品放置前终止回合。重新 take 已放置的物品并将其重新 put 到目的地的不同实例，也可能触发保护。

entries.original: The current state may be misread as satisfying the completion condition even though the actual goal or subgoal is unfinished, causing repeated signals instead of progress; alternatively, the destination instance may be confused, leading to re-taking a placed item.
entries.chinese: 当前状态可能被误读为满足完成条件，即使实际目标或子目标尚未完成，导致反复发出信号而非进展；或者目的地实例可能被混淆，导致重新 take 已放置的物品。

entries.original: When targets are not immediately visible, search broadly. Inspect visible open surfaces (counters, tables, shelves, sofas) first, then open closed containers (cabinets, drawers) before inspecting or taking from inside. Continue across location types until the required instances are found or a checked-location record shows no unchecked likely locations remain. If both instances are visible on one surface, take one, place it, then return to that surface for the second. Treat an unreachable or no-change navigation target as unavailable and move to another candidate. Reassess feasibility after likely locations are exhausted, but do not conclude blocked prematurely.
entries.chinese: 当目标不立即可见时，广泛搜索。先检查可见的开放表面（台面、桌子、架子、沙发），然后 open 关闭的容器（柜子、抽屉），再检查或从内部 take。继续跨位置类型搜索，直到找到所需实例，或已检查位置记录显示没有剩余未检查的可能位置。如果两个实例都可见于同一表面，take 一个，put 它，然后返回该表面取第二个。将不可达或无变化的导航目标视为不可用，并转向另一个候选。在可能位置耗尽后重新评估可行性，但不要过早断定受阻。

entries.original: Search a few high-probability locations first, such as the fridge, countertops, stove burners, dining table, cabinets, drawers, and shelves. Open containers as needed and track visited locations to avoid redundant loops. Distinguish 'arrived at a closed container' from 'inspected and empty': a closed container's contents are unverified until opened. If the target is not in the fridge, continue a bounded systematic search across other plausible surfaces and containers rather than declaring failure after only opening the fridge. If the target is found on an accessible surface, take it directly and proceed. If it is not found after a reasonable broad search, reassess goal feasibility or possible absence rather than searching every unrelated receptacle. Do not repeat an identical broad search after obvious receptacles are exhausted; raise uncertainty early when feasibility is doubtful.
entries.chinese: 先搜索几个高概率位置，如冰箱、台面、炉灶燃烧器、餐桌、柜子、抽屉和架子。根据需要 open 容器，并跟踪已访问位置以避免冗余循环。区分“到达关闭的容器”和“已检查且为空”：关闭容器的内容在打开前未经验证。如果目标不在冰箱中，继续在其他合理表面和容器上进行有界系统搜索，而不是仅打开冰箱后就宣布失败。如果目标在可访问表面上找到，直接 take 它并继续。如果在合理广泛搜索后仍未找到，重新评估目标可行性或可能缺失，而不是搜索每个无关容器。在明显容器耗尽后，不要重复相同的广泛搜索；当可行性存疑时，尽早提高不确定性。

entries.original: A put action can produce no effect if issued before reaching the destination receptacle, or it can fail without the failure being noticed. Continuing to search for the second item after an unconfirmed first placement can leave the goal unsatisfied. When a put returns no change, first verify that the actor is actually at the destination before concluding the receptacle rejects placement; a subsequent go-to-destination followed by a retried put often succeeds. If the destination repeatedly rejects placement after the location cause is ruled out, reassess whether it is valid and report blocked rather than looping or abandoning the held object.
entries.chinese: 如果在到达目标容器之前发出 put 动作，可能不产生任何效果，也可能失败而不被察觉。在第一次放置未确认后继续寻找第二件物品，可能导致目标未满足。当 put 返回无变化时，先确认执行者确实在目标位置，再断定容器拒绝放置；随后 go to 目标位置并重试 put 通常能成功。如果排除位置原因后目标容器仍反复拒绝放置，重新评估它是否有效，并报告 blocked，而不是循环或丢弃手中物品。

entries.original: After several containers have been opened and no target found, repeatedly revisiting locations already confirmed empty, re-taking an already-placed instance, repeating a no-change navigation, or trying yet another receptacle after many failed put attempts can exhaust the action budget and cause failure. A held object whose put attempts fail across many receptacles may indicate an unplaceable object or an infeasible goal rather than a wrong receptacle. Critic should not assert a specific unseen location contains the target or that a failed action was 'transient' without observed evidence.
entries.chinese: 在打开多个容器仍未找到目标后，反复重访已确认空的位置、重新拿取已放置的实例、重复无变化的导航，或在多次 put 失败后继续尝试另一个容器，可能耗尽动作预算并导致失败。手中物品在多个容器上 put 均失败，可能表明该物品不可放置或目标不可行，而不是容器选错。Critic 不应在没有观察证据时断言某个未见的特定位置包含目标，或断言失败动作是“暂时性的”。

entries.original: Searching without tracking checked locations and placed instances leads to redundant actions, while unchecked opened containers or visible surfaces may still contain the target. A no-change navigation indicates the target location is unreachable or invalid, so retrying it cannot help; speculation about unseen contents or transient failures drives further wasted steps.
entries.chinese: 搜索时不记录已检查位置和已放置实例会导致冗余动作，而未检查的已打开容器或可见表面仍可能包含目标。无变化的导航表明目标位置不可达或无效，重试无济于事；对未见内容或暂时性失败的猜测会带来更多浪费步骤。

entries.original: Maintain a list of checked locations and placed instances. Prioritize unchecked opened containers and visible surfaces; take a target directly if it is visible. Avoid revisiting a location confirmed to have no target or re-taking an already-placed object unless new evidence suggests otherwise. After one no-change navigation, choose a different unchecked location. Base advice on observed state rather than asserting unseen contents or transient failures. If every put attempt fails across many receptacles, stop suggesting new receptacles and reassess the held object's exact identifier and whether the destination accepts placement, considering the object unplaceable or the goal infeasible.
entries.chinese: 维护已检查位置和已放置实例的列表。优先检查未检查的已打开容器和可见表面；如果目标可见，直接 take。避免重访已确认无目标的位置，或重新拿取已放置的物品，除非有新证据表明并非如此。一次无变化导航后，选择另一个未检查位置。建议应基于观察到的状态，而不是断言未见内容或暂时性失败。如果所有 put 尝试在多个容器上均失败，停止建议新容器，重新评估手中物品的准确标识符以及目标容器是否接受放置，考虑该物品不可放置或目标不可行。

entries.original: Search should prioritize plausible locations but avoid opening every remaining container indefinitely or declaring blocked prematurely. Track checked locations and avoid revisiting confirmed-empty ones. After a reasonable set of likely locations has been checked—not merely one or two when many plausible ones remain—consider unusual placement or impossibility, then reassess or report blocked. Open surfaces such as stoveburners, countertops, and dining tables must be included, not only cabinets and drawers.
entries.chinese: 搜索应优先考虑可能的位置，但避免无限期打开所有剩余容器或过早宣布 blocked。记录已检查位置，避免重访已确认空的位置。在检查了一组合理的可能位置后——当仍有许多可能位置时，不应只查一两个——考虑异常放置或不可能性，然后重新评估或报告 blocked。必须包括炉灶、台面和餐桌等开放表面，而不仅是柜子和抽屉。

entries.original: Item locations may follow regularities, but unusual placement or impossible tasks can occur; unbounded search wastes steps and can cause timeout, while stopping too early can miss findable objects. Restricting search to closed containers misses objects placed on open surfaces.
entries.chinese: 物品位置可能遵循规律，但也可能出现异常放置或不可能任务；无界搜索浪费步骤并可能导致超时，而过早停止可能错过可找到的物品。仅搜索关闭容器会错过放在开放表面上的物品。

entries.original: Prioritize likely locations by object type: food-related items in fridge; dishes or utensils in countertop, cabinet, or drawer; pots/kettles/pans on stoveburners; cleaning supplies near sinkbasin, countertop, or shelf. Keep a record of checked locations. After several likely locations fail, consider unusual placement or impossibility and reassess or report blocked rather than exhaustively opening all containers or stopping after only a couple of empty locations.
entries.chinese: 按物品类型优先考虑可能位置：食物相关物品在 fridge；餐具或器皿在 countertop、cabinet 或 drawer；锅/水壶/平底锅在 stoveburners；清洁用品在 sinkbasin、countertop 或 shelf 附近。记录已检查位置。在多个可能位置失败后，考虑异常放置或不可能性，并重新评估或报告 blocked，而不是穷举打开所有容器，或只在几个空位置后就停止。

entries.original: Search a few high-probability locations first, such as the fridge, countertops, stove burners, dining table, cabinets, drawers, and shelves. Prefer open visible surfaces (countertop, diningtable) before exhaustive closed-container sweeps. Open containers as needed and track visited locations to avoid redundant loops. If the target is not in the fridge, continue a bounded systematic search across other plausible surfaces and containers rather than declaring failure after only opening the fridge. If the target is found on an accessible surface, take it directly and proceed. If it is not found after a reasonable broad search, reassess goal feasibility or possible absence rather than searching every unrelated receptacle. Do not repeat an identical broad search after obvious receptacles are exhausted; raise uncertainty early when feasibility is doubtful.
entries.chinese: 先搜索几个高概率位置，例如 fridge、countertops、stove burners、dining table、cabinets、drawers 和 shelves。优先检查开放可见表面（countertop、diningtable），再穷举关闭容器。按需打开容器并记录已访问位置，避免冗余循环。如果目标不在 fridge，继续在其他可能表面和容器中进行有界系统搜索，而不是只打开 fridge 后就宣布失败。如果目标在可接近表面上找到，直接 take 并继续。如果在合理广泛搜索后仍未找到，重新评估目标可行性或可能缺失，而不是搜索每个无关容器。在明显容器耗尽后，不要重复相同的广泛搜索；当可行性存疑时，尽早提出不确定性。

entries.original: Use environment feedback as authority. Acquire the exact target; go to the fridge and open it; while holding the target at the open fridge, issue the explicit cooling interaction cool <object> with fridge <id>. Do not place the object into the fridge and re-take it as a substitute for cooling. Wait for a cooled-state confirmation before leaving. Then go to the destination, open it if closed, put the object there, and confirm placement. Do not treat mere containment, brief placement, or a fridge round-trip as confirmed cooling. Do not re-take an object already held; check inventory first. After successful cooling while holding, proceed directly to the destination rather than adding a take-from-fridge step.
entries.chinese: 以环境反馈为准。获取准确目标；go to fridge 并 open；在打开 fridge 且手持目标时，发出显式冷却交互 cool <object> with fridge <id>。不要将物品放入 fridge 再重新 take 作为冷却替代。离开前等待冷却状态确认。然后 go to 目标位置，如果关闭则 open，将物品 put 到那里，并确认放置。不要将仅仅容纳、短暂放置或 fridge 往返视为已确认冷却。不要重新 take 已持有的物品；先检查 inventory。手持物品冷却成功后，直接前往目标位置，不要增加 take-from-fridge 步骤。

entries.original: A clean action may produce no effect when the target is not held, the current location is not a valid cleaning fixture, or the object is unsuitable. Cleaning is reliably supported at a sinkbasin in observations; alternatives such as bathtubbasin or fridge should not be assumed equivalent. Repeated identical clean attempts waste steps. Trying to take another object while still holding the failed object may also produce repeated no-ops. A clean attempted while not actually at the sinkbasin will return no effect even if the command names the sinkbasin.
entries.chinese: 当目标未被持有、当前位置不是有效清洁设施或物品不适合时，clean 动作可能不产生效果。观察中 sinkbasin 可靠支持清洁；不应假定 bathtubbasin 或 fridge 等替代设施等效。重复相同的 clean 尝试浪费步骤。在仍持有失败物品时尝试 take 另一物品，也可能反复无操作。即使命令中命名了 sinkbasin，如果实际不在 sinkbasin，clean 也会返回无效果。

entries.original: The environment appears to validate that the object is held and that cleaning occurs at a compatible fixture; not every fixture or object supports cleaning, and naming a fixture in the command does not substitute for being at it.
entries.chinese: 环境似乎会验证物品被持有且清洁发生在兼容设施上；并非每个设施或物品都支持清洁，在命令中命名设施不能替代实际位于该设施。

entries.original: Hold the target, navigate to a sinkbasin, then clean. If no effect, first verify the actor is actually at the sinkbasin before retrying; then verify the held object and current location; try a different sinkbasin or confirm the object is cleanable. Treat bathtubbasin as unverified and switch to sinkbasin if it fails. After a failed clean, either try a different cleanable candidate after releasing the held object at a valid surface or report the object as not cleanable; do not loop on the same action.
entries.chinese: 持有目标，导航到 sinkbasin，然后 clean。如果无效果，先确认执行者确实在 sinkbasin 再重试；然后确认手中物品和当前位置；尝试另一个 sinkbasin 或确认物品可清洁。将 bathtubbasin 视为未验证，如果失败则改用 sinkbasin。clean 失败后，要么在有效表面放下手中物品后尝试另一个可清洁候选，要么报告该物品不可清洁；不要在同一动作上循环。

entries.original: Use environment feedback as authority. Acquire the exact target; go to the fridge and open it; while holding the target at the open fridge, use the available cooling interaction. If an explicit cool action is available, issue it for the target and fridge; otherwise use the available cooling interaction. Wait for a cooled-state confirmation before leaving. Then go to the destination, open it if closed, put the object there, and confirm placement. Do not treat mere containment, brief placement, or a fridge round-trip as confirmed cooling. Do not re-take an object already held; check inventory first. After successful cooling while holding, proceed directly to the destination rather than adding a take-from-fridge step. Do not emit a completion/handoff signal at the cooling milestone; cooling is only an intermediate checkpoint and the goal also requires placement.
entries.chinese: 以环境反馈为准。获取准确目标；go to fridge 并 open；在打开 fridge 且手持目标时，使用可用的冷却交互。如果有显式 cool 动作，对目标和 fridge 发出；否则使用可用的冷却交互。离开前等待冷却状态确认。然后 go to 目标位置，如果关闭则 open，将物品 put 到那里，并确认放置。不要将仅仅容纳、短暂放置或 fridge 往返视为已确认冷却。不要重新 take 已持有的物品；先检查 inventory。手持物品冷却成功后，直接前往目标位置，不要增加 take-from-fridge 步骤。不要在冷却里程碑发出完成/交接信号；冷却只是中间检查点，目标还要求放置。

entries.original: Placing the object directly without cooling, or stopping after opening the fridge or cooling the object without final placement, leaves the goal incomplete. The task requires both a cooled object and placement at the specified destination. Declaring success when the cooled state was never confirmed also fails the goal even if the object was placed.
entries.chinese: 未冷却就直接放置物品，或在打开 fridge 或冷却物品后停止而未最终放置，都会使目标不完整。任务要求物品已冷却并放置到指定目标位置。在冷却状态从未确认时宣布成功，即使物品已放置，也会导致目标失败。

entries.original: The goal can be misread as simple placement, or cooling can be treated as the whole mission. Declaring completion after a partial step, or after repeated cooling failures, also causes failure.
entries.chinese: 目标可能被误读为简单放置，或冷却被当作整个任务。在部分步骤后宣布完成，或在反复冷却失败后宣布完成，也会导致失败。

entries.original: Treat cooling and final placement as separate checkpoints. Include an explicit cooling step before placement when a cool object is required, then continue to the destination and place the object. Do not declare success until both the cooled state and destination placement have been confirmed; if cooling repeatedly failed, do not signal completion on placement alone.
entries.chinese: 将冷却和最终放置视为独立检查点。当需要冷却物品时，在放置前包含显式冷却步骤，然后继续前往目标位置并放置物品。在冷却状态和目标位置放置均确认前，不要宣布成功；如果冷却反复失败，不要仅凭放置就发出完成信号。

entries.original: After several containers have been opened and no target found, repeatedly revisiting locations already confirmed empty, re-taking an already-placed instance, repeating a no-change navigation, or trying yet another receptacle after many failed put attempts can exhaust the action budget and cause failure. A held object whose put attempts fail across many receptacles may indicate an unplaceable object or an infeasible goal rather than a wrong receptacle. Declaring failure before all plausible open surfaces and closed containers have actually been opened and inspected also causes failure.
entries.chinese: 在打开多个容器仍未找到目标后，反复重访已确认空的位置、重新拿取已放置的实例、重复无变化的导航，或在多次 put 失败后继续尝试另一个容器，可能耗尽动作预算并导致失败。手中物品在多个容器上 put 均失败，可能表明该物品不可放置或目标不可行，而不是容器选错。在所有可能的开放表面和关闭容器实际被打开并检查之前就宣布失败，也会导致失败。

entries.original: Searching without tracking checked locations and placed instances leads to redundant actions, while unchecked opened containers or visible surfaces may still contain the target. A no-change navigation indicates the target location is unreachable or invalid, so retrying it cannot help. Premature failure declaration leaves plausible locations unexamined.
entries.chinese: 搜索时不记录已检查位置和已放置实例会导致冗余动作，而未检查的已打开容器或可见表面仍可能包含目标。无变化的导航表明目标位置不可达或无效，重试无济于事。过早宣布失败会使可能位置未被检查。

entries.original: Maintain a list of checked locations and placed instances. Prioritize unchecked opened containers and visible surfaces; take a target directly if it is visible. Avoid revisiting a location confirmed to have no target or re-taking an already-placed object unless new evidence suggests otherwise. After one no-change navigation, choose a different unchecked location. Before declaring blocked, ensure all plausible open surfaces and closed containers were actually opened and inspected. If every put attempt fails across many receptacles, stop suggesting new receptacles and reassess the held object's exact identifier and whether the destination accepts placement, considering the object unplaceable or the goal infeasible.
entries.chinese: 维护已检查位置和已放置实例的列表。优先检查未检查的已打开容器和可见表面；如果目标可见，直接 take。避免重访已确认无目标的位置，或重新拿取已放置的物品，除非有新证据表明并非如此。一次无变化导航后，选择另一个未检查位置。在宣布 blocked 前，确保所有可能的开放表面和关闭容器实际被打开并检查。如果所有 put 尝试在多个容器上均失败，停止建议新容器，重新评估手中物品的准确标识符以及目标容器是否接受放置，考虑该物品不可放置或目标不可行。

entries.original: Track checked locations and avoid premature absence conclusions
entries.chinese: 记录已检查位置，避免过早得出缺失结论

entries.original: Recover from no-change actions by changing location, state, or strategy
entries.chinese: 通过改变位置、状态或策略，从无变化的动作中恢复

entries.original: Verify the final observed state before declaring success and stop after confirmation
entries.chinese: 在宣布成功前核实最终观察到的状态，确认后停止

entries.original: Cleaning fails when fixture, location, or held object is wrong
entries.chinese: 当固定设施、位置或手持物体错误时，清洁会失败

entries.original: Some objects are not cleanable with a sinkbasin
entries.chinese: 有些物体无法用 sinkbasin 清洁
